meta.purpose: Reference database for methods section — iBioMed 2026 paper
meta.paper_title: When Unsure, Predict Broader: Uncertainty-Gated Coarse Fallback for Hierarchical Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification
notes: BANNED: arXiv:2405.11533 (Goren/Galil/El-Yaniv, Hierarchical Selective Classification, Technion Israel) — permanent institutional constraint. Replace with deng2012hedging + mortier2026confhier.
DATASET MISMATCH: methods draft Section B lists PadChest/Open-I/RSNA Pneumonia — actual ingested datasets are NIH/CheXpert/VinDr-CXR/VinDr-PCXR/TBX11K/COVIDx. Update draft before submission.
status field: 'local' = PDF in reference/, 'arxiv' = freely available on arXiv (no local copy), 'needs_fetch' = accessible but not yet downloaded, 'banned' = must not cite.

papers.title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks
papers.role: DenseNet121 backbone architecture

papers.title: TorchXRayVision: A library of chest X-ray datasets and models
papers.role: TorchXRayVision pretrained weights (densenet121-res224-all); multi-CXR pretraining protocol

papers.title: Clinically-Inspired Hierarchical Multi-Label Classification of Chest X-rays with a Penalty-Based Loss Function
papers.institution: Concordia University / McGill University Health Centre
papers.role: Primary prior work. HBCE loss formulation (Eq. 1 in our paper); MC-Dropout at inference; nearest published baseline

papers.title: Dropout as a Bayesian Approximation: Representing Model Uncertainty in Deep Learning
papers.role: Theoretical foundation for MC-Dropout uncertainty estimation; justifies T=30 stochastic forward passes as Bayesian approximation

papers.title: A Novel Characterization of the Population Area Under the Risk Coverage Curve (AURC) and Rates of Finite Sample Estimators
papers.role: AURC plug-in estimator (â'_i = -ln(1 - r_i/(n+1))) used for selective prediction evaluation; formalizes population AURC

papers.title: Hedging Your Bets: Optimizing Accuracy-Specificity Trade-offs in Large Scale Visual Recognition
papers.role: Origin of coarse-retreat concept: retreating to a coarser prediction when uncertain preserves accuracy while sacrificing specificity. Motivates our uncertainty-gated fallback.

papers.title: Conformal Prediction in Hierarchical Classification with Constrained Representation Complexity
papers.role: Formal framework for hierarchical inference fallback: CRSVP algorithm climbs to ancestor node when uncertain. Our MC-Dropout gate is a simpler variant without coverage guarantees; cite as formal motivation.

papers.title: Grad-CAM: Visual Explanations from Deep Networks via Gradient-based Localization
papers.role: Grad-CAM localization method applied at final convolutional block for XAI evaluation

papers.title: Interpreting Chest X-Rays via CNNs that Exploit Hierarchical Disease Dependencies and Uncertainty Labels
papers.role: Related work: conditional hierarchical training + MC-Dropout for CXR. Uses conditional probability factoring (not HBCE). MC-Dropout for display only, not gating — key difference from our work.

papers.title: Label Co-occurrence Learning with Graph Convolutional Networks for Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Image Classification
papers.role: Related work: first HMLC framing for CXR, two-stage conditional training. Predates HBCE; motivates hierarchy-aware training.

papers.title: CheXpert: A Large Chest Radiograph Dataset with Uncertainty Labels and Expert Comparison
papers.role: CheXpert dataset citation; U-Zero uncertain label policy; 14-label taxonomy

papers.title: ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks
papers.role: NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset citation; 112,120 frontal CXRs, 14-label taxonomy

papers.title: MIMIC-CXR: A large publicly available database of labeled chest radiographs
papers.institution: MIT / Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
papers.role: MIMIC-CXR-JPG dataset citation (pending download); 227,827 CXRs, 14-label NLP-extracted taxonomy

papers.title: VinDr-CXR: An open dataset of chest X-rays with radiologist annotations
papers.role: VinDr-CXR dataset citation; 18,000 CXRs with multi-radiologist consensus, 28-label taxonomy

papers.title: COVID-Net: A Tailored Deep Convolutional Neural Network Design for Detection of COVID-19 Cases from Chest X-Ray Images
papers.role: COVIDx-CXR4 dataset citation; COVID-19 CXR benchmark dataset

papers.title: Rethinking Computer-Aided Tuberculosis Diagnosis
papers.role: TBX11K dataset citation; 11,200 CXRs with TB annotations and bounding boxes

papers.title: CheXmask-U: Quantifying Uncertainty in Landmark-Based Anatomical Segmentation for X-Ray Images
papers.institution: CONICET / Universidad Nacional del Litoral, Argentina
papers.role: CheXmask-U segmentation masks with per-node uncertainty; 657,566 masks across MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, VinDr-CXR, NIH. Used for segmentation conditioning (Factor 2 in ablation).

papers.title: Benchmarking Uncertainty and Its Disentanglement in Multi-label Chest X-Ray Classification
papers.venue: UNSURE Workshop at MICCAI 2025, LNCS vol. 16166
papers.role: Related work: 13 UQ methods benchmarked on MIMIC-CXR multi-label. No hierarchical label structure. Provides comparison baseline for UQ evaluation.

papers.title: Deep Mining External Imperfect Data for Chest X-Ray Disease Classification
papers.role: Related work: multi-dataset adversarial domain adaptation + pseudo-label training for CXR. Motivates our masked BCE for label discrepancy handling.

papers.title: Label-Efficient Self-Supervised Federated Learning for Tackling Data Heterogeneity in Healthcare
papers.role: Related work: partial-label assembly for multi-dataset CXR training. Dynamic class query adapter. Context for our NaN masking approach.

papers.title: CXR-LT 2024: A MICCAI Challenge on Long-tailed, Multi-label, and Zero-shot Disease Classification from Chest X-ray
papers.institution: Multi-institutional (Minnesota, UT Austin, Cornell, Yale, Mayo)
papers.role: Related work: long-tail multi-label CXR challenge on MIMIC-CXR, 45 labels. Motivates mAP as metric. Confirms multi-dataset + ensemble as current practice.

papers.title: LMeRAN: Label Masking-Enhanced Residual Attention Network for Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Disease Aided Diagnosis
papers.institution: Beijing Forestry University / China Academy of Chinese Medicine
papers.role: Related work: DenseNet121 + residual label attention for CXR. mAUC 0.825 on NIH. Baseline comparison point.

papers.title: Pathology Aware Hierarchical Transformers for Multi-Label Thoracic Disease Classification Using Chest X-Rays
papers.role: Related work: hierarchical pathology-aware ViT with two-stage attention. macro-F1 0.924 on COVIDx+NIH. Context for ViT vs CNN comparison.

papers.title: Hierarchical Selective Classification
papers.role: BANNED — Technion (Israel). Permanent institutional constraint. Replace with deng2012hedging (coarse-retreat concept) and mortier2026confhier (formal hierarchical abstention framework).
